[debezium] The value of date type is not issued normally.

hello

I don't know what the "birthday": 6251 value actually accumulated in kafka means.

thank you

evidence.quote: a `DATE` column for this mode is converted to an INT32, which represents the number of days since epoch. So in short, 6251 is the number of days since 1970-01-01 and 1987-02-12.

notes: DATE emitted as io.debezium.time.Date (days since epoch) by design; the value converter code shows the intended mapping. Reads like corrupted data.
